verdict.rationale: Mollie's Settlement Report gives a per-payout breakdown of all transactions, fees and deductions for reconciliation. A Settlements API and the Balances API add programmatic access to settlement and balance history. Nothing in the evidence shows the user can control the payout schedule, so only the reconciliation half of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: any documented payout-schedule control (frequency or timing), explicit itemization of refunds and chargebacks within a payout, detailed Settlements API docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout

citations.quote: Settlement Report gives you a complete breakdown of the data included in a specific payout. It shows all transactions, fees and deductions that are part of a single settlement.
The Balances API allows you to retrieve real-time as well as historical information about your Mollie balance. This may be useful to for example integrate Mollie into your bookkeeping.
